headline: Rain Expected Through the Weekend
text:
Rain Expected Through the Weekend

The forecast calls for rain through the weekend, with a chance of clearing by Monday morning. The report recommends three changes: shorter meetings, clearer agendas and more time for public comment. A spokesperson for the department declined to comment on the specifics, saying only that a full report would be released soon. Teachers and parents have raised concerns about class sizes, and the district says it is reviewing staffing levels. A small group of volunteers spent the morning clearing debris from the trail after the storm.
